newsitem.title: USA: Airtouch sees reaching 1997 cash-flow goal.
newsitem.headline: Airtouch sees reaching 1997 cash-flow goal.

text.p: AirTouch International Inc said on Monday that based on first-quarter results it expects to achieve its 1997 goal of reaching $1.5 billion in proportionate operating cash flow.
AirTouch also said it expects its international cellular operations as a whole to be profitable in 1997.
AirTouch reported first-quarter earnings per share of $0.13, compared with $0.10 for the same period the year before. The First Call estimate was $0.11.
AirTouch said its U.S. paging operations added 73,000 units in service, boosting its total to more than 2.9 million.
AirTouch has interests in cellular, paging and personal communications services worldwide, as well as an interest in the Globalstar satellite system.
